translation.name: Pwapwior we e Santus
translation.englishName: Satawalese: Pwapwior we e Santus (New Testament)

content: Jesus a Fenai me Weei Rhug
Igiwe Jesus a weri pwuwaen aeremas kkewe, iwe a ittae wooan eew rhug a ittae mooat tiw. Rhooan kkayeo kkewe naiun ra itto reen.
Iwe, Jesus a rhaepetae aan fenai ngaeniir:
Oanongonniuwaen Wenepwu

content.text: “Ra wenepwu rhooan giuneei pwe ngeoniiur e affayeo;
pwe iir repwe mweoiuni Mweoiu Naaeng.
Ra wenepwu rhooa nee tip cchoaw nee tipeer,
Ra wenepwu rhooan mwerhaen feeori minne epwiung me faaen mesaen Deus,
pwe Deus epwe fang ngaeniir minikkena re tipaeni.
pwe Deus epwe pwan ffayeo ngaeniir.
Ra wenepwu rhooa nimegacch nee tipeer,
pwe Deus epwe faingiir pwe iir naiun.
Ra wenepwu rhooa aewwaeiraes reen aar feeori nee tipaen Deus,
pwe iir repwe mweoiuni Mweoiu Naaeng.

content: “Oaw wenepwu aaemi rhooana re ffeeoretae kkepesaemi, nge re aewwaeiraesigaemi, me aepesa aenneewagaemi pwe aegin ngaang.
Oawkker nge a mwamwaai nee tipaemi, pwe a yor paniuwaemi ina e igin faeregit me naaeng. Pwe ieei wunuunun aar pwan aewwaeiraesiir profeta kkewe regommw me mmwaemi.
Aesiig me Seram

“Aaemi oawwa taeppen rhag aesiig faaen iteer aeremesaen feoniufan. Pwe aere aesiig esa saaet no, esoapw mmwen sipwe aesaaeti sefaaeniy. Iwe esa yor no ipitan, epwe aekkaerh wow pwe aeremas repwe pwuri fetaeneei.
“Aaemi seremaen feoniufan. Eew aepinoamw ne eno wooan eew rhug esoapw mmwenen mwoanonoa.
Esooar erhai aeremas ne epwe figi eew oappwun nge a iseni nong faaen eew saepiy, pwe epwe faer iseni tae wooan nenien, pwe epwe aesseremaar rhooan iimw we.
Epwe ieei wunuunun seremaemi aan epwe ttin memmweer aeremas, pwe repwe giuneei aaemi wegitaeg mwamwaai iwe nge re aepingepinga Semaemi me wooai naaeng.
Jesus a Fenaiuw Wunuunun Anniug

“Oawsoapw niunniuwaennei pwe iya itto pwe ipwe oamoai noa Anniug kkewe aaen Moses me aar profeta kkewe kkepesaen fenai. Ngaang ise itto pwe ipwe itto oamoai noa, pwe ifaer itto pwe ipwe pwaeritae minna wenewenen.
Ennetaen, ipwe aengaenigaemi, pwe epat mwo aere efai mwo iirh me reen anniug eei nge esoapw aekkaerh noa toori aan toarop noa naaeng me soanop pwan toori aan epwe moann oanongaen meeta.

Iwe, ngaere erhai ese tapweei mwo nge eew anniug mwittig kkeei nge e oasuguuna ngaeniir aaemweoi pwe repwe pwan taeppen iiy, iiy epwe igin sessoan me noan Mweoiu Naaeng. Ngaere erhai epwe tapweei iiy anniug kkeei nge e oasuguuna ngaeniir aaemweoi pwe repwe pwan taeppen iiy, iiy epwe taegias me noan Mweoiu Naaeng.
Ipwe aengaenigaemi, pwe aaemi oawpwe mmwenen toonong rhag noan Mweoiu Naaeng igine aaemi e mwamwaai wegitaegimi saengiir sinsein anniug me Pharisees kkewe.
Fenaiuw Wunuunun Soong
“Oawwa rongorong aar aengaeniir aeremesaen mweoiwe pwe, ‘Wosoapw nni menaw aeremas. Iyo enni menaw aeremas epwe toonong noan nenien apwiung.’

Nge ngaang ipwene aengaenigaemi: iyo e esoong ngaeni pwiin nge epwe noa noan nenien apwiung, nge iyo e aengaeni pwiin pwe, ‘Een esooar ipitoamw,’ epwe noa noan nenien apwiung na e taegias, nge iyo e aengaeni pwiin pwe, ‘Een wopwurh,’ nge epwe noa noan aengaetaen nifierno.
Iwe aere wopwe pwigitae oamw oasoar ngaeni Deus wooan antar, nge a maeng ngaeniug pwe pwiimw ecchoaw tipan woamw,
wa nigiti mwo oasoar we oamw weni mmwan antar nge wa sefaaen, pwe oawpwe oamwusomwus fengaen. Mwirin wa sefaaeneto pwigitae oasoar we oamw ngaeni Deus.

“Aere erhai a mwerhaen pwigiug noa noan nenien apwiung, wopwe mwetekkaein saeneti ffin nipwaen iga e rhiuwen yor oaton, weni mmwaen iga wopwe toori nenien apwiung. Pwe oatona wopwe toori rhag nenien apwiung, ina nge een wopwene noa reen soaw apwiung we, nge iiy epwene aefengoag noa nee paiiur police, nge iir repwene iseniug nong noan kanepwus.
Ennetaen, ipwe aengaenigaemi, pwe iginaan iga wopwe noa no e toori oamw wopwe piungiutiw oanongaen paniuwaen monofitimw.
Fenaiun Oamonofitin Maiur Ngaeniir Maan Pwiuppwiuniuw
“Oawwa rongorong pwe re aepesa pwe, ‘Wosoapw maiur ngaeni pwiuniuwaen erhai.’
Nge ngaang ipwe aengaenigaemi pwe: aere erhai mwaaen a pipiiy erhai rhooapwut nge a rig nee tipan ngaeni, iiy a fasiun monofit reen aan maiur ngaeni pwiuniuwaen erhai me noan nee tipan.

Iwe, aere ifirhin mesoamw e paeniug nong noan monofit, oannusuwow wa oatoranoa. Efaer gacch igine egiufet ireiren oanongoamw epwe ppiungiunoa, mmwaen igine wunusaen oanongoamw epwe aekkaerhnong noan nifierno.
Ngaere ifirhin poawumw e paeniug nong noan monofit, gopiy noa wa oatoranoa. Efaer gacch igine egiufet ireiren oanongoamw epwe ppiungiunoa, mmwaen igine wunusaen oanongoamw epwe toonong noan nifierno.
Fenaiuw Wunuunun Mweoinoa
“Epwan aepesa pwe, ‘Erhai ne e asiuw noa pwiuniuwan nge epwe ngaenneei niewe erheo pwapwioron mweoinoa.’

Nge ngaang ipwe aengaenigaemi: aere erhai mwaaen a mweoi saengi pwiuniuwan reen ese tiwegin meeta ppweoniun, nge soapw reen aaen niewe maiur ngaeni pwiuniuwaen erhai, iwe wonowe minne a monofit pwe a feeori niewe epwe oamonofit reen aan pwiuppwiuniuw sefaaen, nge iiy mwaaen na a pwiuniuwaeni, ina iiy a pwan feeori monofit.
Fenaiuw Wunuunun Aekkepan
“Oawwa pwan rongorong aar aengaeniir aeremesaen mweoiwe pwe, ‘Wosoapw misimis oamw aekkepan, nge wopwe faer feeori meeta e oamw aekkepan
ngaeni Deus.’
Nge ngaang ipwe aengaenigaemi: wosoapw aekkepan rhag. Wosoapw aekkepan faaen itaen naaeng, pwe ina nenien Deus,
nge soapw pwan faaen itaen soanop, pwe ina aaen Deus nenien aseoseon pirheen, nge soapw pwan faaen itaen Jerusalem, pwe ina aepinoamwon King we egin taegias.
Wosoapw pwan aekkepan mwo nge faaen itaen rhimwemw, pwe wosoapw mmwenen aepwerhepwerha aere oarhonaanoa eyaen aennirhimwemw.
Wopwe aepesa, ‘Ewaer,’ aere ‘Aapw,’ pwe ese tiwegin minne wonaaen aepesa nge e itto saengi Man Aenneew we.
Fenaiuw Wunuunun Appaniuwaenin Aenneew

“Oawwa rongorong pwe re aepesa pwe, ‘Aere erhai e aettiwow efai mesoamw nge paniuwaenin wa pwan aettiwow efai mesan, nge aere erhai e aettiwow efoarh ngiimw, nge paniuwaenin wa pwan aettiwow efoarh ngiin.’

Nge ngaang ipwe aengaenigaemi: oawsoapw paniuwaeni aaen aeremas aenneew ngaenigaemi. Aere erhai e ppeosepa ne oawusupoamw me wooan peig mwaaenemw, pwan wegeti ngaeni ne oawusupoamw me wooan peig rhooapwutomw.
Aere erhai e pwigiug noa noan nenien apwiung pwe epwe pwigi mengaagiumw mengaag, faer pwan nigiti ngaeni siketa na pwe pwan mengaagiun.
Aere erhai sonotaw e akkiuneog pwe wopwe pwigi ngaeni pisaegin noan eew mile, faer pwigi ngaeni noan ruwowu miles.
Aere erhai a tingoareog meeta oamw, ngaenneei, ngaere erhai a mwerhaen aeyae mwo meeta pisaegimw, fang ngaeni.
Fenaiuw Wunuunun Aarh Sipwe Aerhaengiir Rhooan Oapwutaegirh
“Oawwa rongorong pwe re aepesa pwe, ‘Oaw aerhaengiir rhooan weni oaromi, nge oaw oapwutaar rhooan oapwutaegaemi.’
Nge ngaang ipwe aengaenigaemi: oawpwe aerhaengiir rhooan oapwutaegaemi nge oawwa maeipin faaen iteer rhooakkena re aewwaeiraesigaemi,

pwe oawpwe no pwe naiun minna Semaemi wooai naaeng. Pwe iya aettina feeorian aenet wooar aeremas aenneew me aeremas gacch, nge a apiungiutiw worhow wooar rhooakkena reffeeor mwamwaai me rhooakkena reffeeor aenneew.
Meeta faan Deus epwe fang niffengaemi aere oaw aerhaengiir rhag rhooa na re aerhaengigaemi? Pwan rhooan iyoiyon mwo tax nge refeeori minna.
Aere weni maereyaeremi rhag minne wogaen kekkepas ngaeniir, ina nge minna wofeeori nge ese pwan wen saengiir aaemweoi. Pwan re Gentiles mwo nge refeeori taeppen minna.
Iwe aaemi oawpwe igin menaw gacch pwe oawpwe taeppen rhag gacchiun minna Semaemi wooai naaeng.

footnotes.text: aekkepan: ppwon faaen mesaen Deus ngaere aeremas
